caption: The plan screen opens straight after the install, before any onboarding: Free (10 videos, watermark), Pro at $14.00 a month and Advanced at $45.00, both with 7 trial days. The store name is hidden.

Shopify's approval screen for Pro shows $14,00 every 30 days after a 7-day trial ending 24 Nov, the same as the plan card before taxes. It asks for a payment method, and we approved nothing. The store name is hidden.
The upload screen on the Free plan. We uploaded no video in this test, so we never saw a story play on the store. The store name is hidden.
On Free the Lead Form page shows the whole form, but the Enable switch is greyed out: lead capture needs Pro or Advanced. The store name is hidden.
Videos can go on products, collections, the homepage or pages. With no video uploaded we linked nothing. The store name is hidden.
